title: Umbral Manipulations
subtitle: Tenebris - blood remembers shadow
text: Umbral blood has absorbed long hours in darkness. Void Shroud (QUICK) veils you in shadow for five seconds. Umbral Step (QUICK) steps to a safe shadow beside or above the block you aim at, and Umbral Reversal (QUICK) slips backward into nearby darkness and Obscures those left behind. Black Veil Covenant (QUICK) raises a veil of synthetic darkness; inside your own veil you gain Resistance and fire protection at the cost of weakness. Blood Eclipse (QUICK) Obscures enemy perception beyond four blocks, and held it opens a dome of dark round you that grows as you hold it, Obscures what you may harm inside and hides what stands in it; click and it ends in a flash. Sculpting, Absorption: held toward candles, campfires, Lux traces or a lit gouge run it draws their light in and leaves a field of dark where it burned. Gloam Laceration (QUICK) rakes the creature before you with shadow and leaves it bleeding, and held it puts out the razor, a short dark lash ending in three tails. Umbral Rend (QUICK) tears open every Obscured enemy before you. Penumbral Drift (CONTINUOUS) sheds ordinary attention while it lasts. Eclipse Well (CHARGED) opens a well of darkness that pulls enemies in. Conjure Claws reshapes a held Living Staff into living claws.
